authority: Protected static Storage write-receipt adapter, read independently of candidates. Each receipt is the one Storage sealed with an original at write time: its exact Store and source commitment, its write-time recipe, the resource manifest of that recipe tuple and the original's SP-1101 binding (Storage instance, scope, Server, Project, event type, event and idempotency identity, owner operation and source commitment). Original native write-recipe provenance and immutable receipt authentication remain NOT_RUN. Batch 2 fix 1 (SP-1101): every retained original, strict-v4 included, selects its recipe only from its own receipt. custody_stores lists the Stores whose write custody this catalogue holds; an original of any other Store is unavailable; an original with no receipt is unavailable; more than one receipt for one original (the deliberate ambiguous_receipt negatives) is unsupported; a receipt whose binding is another original (the deliberate receipt_for_other_original negatives) is unavailable; a receipt naming a recipe or resources with no installed frozen verifier (raw-v0 here, resource_manifest_sha256 null) is unsupported. No case falls back to strict-v4 or any other recipe, and callers cannot enroll an original. Owner-invalid strict-v4 originals the fixtures retain (Storage sealed their bytes; their frozen verifier refuses them) carry the receipt their writer sealed, so each refuses at its own verifier row. Readers never write here.
